stories.question: We already have the germline VCFs for these two genomes. Rank their variants by how likely each is to cause a rare disease.

why.route: The question asks for an analysis of the user's own sequenced samples; the router sends that to nextseek_query, whose pipeline agent offers the nf-core run.
why.pipelines: Ranking variants by how likely they are to cause a rare disease needs nf-core/raredisease (annotation and pathogenicity scoring), which NExtSEEK cannot launch yet, so the reply should say not yet and build nothing. The user already has the VCFs, so sarek (calling only, and with vep/snpeff unavailable) adds nothing and is not a right offer. The cohort is two unrelated blood donors with no phenotype, which the reply may also say.

ruling.note: Ruled by an independent Fable reviewer agent on the owner's instruction (2026-10-26). A careful agent could offer sarek as a first step (calling before ranking), which the not_yet rule fails. The user now says the VCFs already exist, so calling is not wanted and only the ranking, which needs raredisease, remains.
